capability.summary: Parse one natural-language date expression into an ISO timestamp
capability.description: Passes one text string to dateparser.parse and returns the parsed datetime as an ISO-8601 string, or null when no date can be recognized.
capability.problem_space: Single-expression date and time interpretation; not recurring-schedule extraction or timezone conversion configuration.

constraint.io_signature: Input: one natural-language text string; output: JSON object echoing text and containing parsed as an ISO datetime string or null.
accepted_inputs: a natural-language date or datetime expression
an ISO-like date string or other text understood by the installed dateparser settings
constraint.output_shape: Success is an object with status="success", tool="lib.dateparser_parse", text as the original input string, and parsed as an ISO-8601 datetime string or null when dateparser recognizes no date. A caught parsing exception produces an object with status="error", tool="lib.dateparser_parse", and message as the exception string, then exits with code 1.
limitations: uses dateparser defaults with no explicit locale, timezone, or relative-base settings
does not return multiple dates from a longer document
ambiguous expressions may resolve according to library defaults
returns null for unrecognized text rather than a ranked set of candidates

output_contract.description: ISO-8601 representation of the parsed datetime, or null when unrecognized.

json_schema.description: Native JSON representation only; no field or task-delivery guarantee.

intent_tags: convert one date expression to an ISO timestamp
negative_intents: extract every date from a document
